Class ShoppingManager

java.lang.Object
Business.ShoppingManager
public class ShoppingManager extends Object
Orchestrates shopping cart operations and checkout. Resolves the full Product from a ProductStock entry, applies the client's pricing strategy multiplier, and manages stock decrements and sale recording during checkout.

  • Method Details

    • addToCart

      public void addToCart(ShoppingCart cart, ProductStock productStock, Provider provider, Customer client) throws BusinessException
      Resolves the full product from the given stock entry, verifies the client is allowed to purchase it, calculates the client-adjusted final price via Customer.calculateFinalPrice(Product, double), and adds the resulting Item to the cart.
      Parameters:
      cart - the shopping cart to add the item to
      productStock - the provider's stock entry identifying the product and base price
      provider - the provider supplying the product
      client - the currently logged-in client
      Throws:
      BusinessException - if the client cannot purchase this product type, or if the product cannot be loaded from the data source

    • getCartTotal

      public double getCartTotal(ShoppingCart cart, Customer client)
      Returns the total price the client will pay for the cart contents, including any one-time shipping surcharge for OnlineClient customers.
      Parameters:
      cart - the shopping cart
      client - the currently logged-in client
      Returns:
      the sum of all item prices plus the client's shipping cost

    • removeFromCart

      public void removeFromCart(ShoppingCart cart, int index)
      Removes the item at the given zero-based index from the cart.
      Parameters:
      cart - the shopping cart to modify
      index - the zero-based index of the item to remove

    • checkout

      public void checkout(ShoppingCart cart, Customer client) throws BusinessException
      Processes the checkout for all items in the cart. For each item: records a sale via SaleManager and decrements the provider's stock by 1 unit. Clears the cart on success.
      Parameters:
      cart - the cart containing the items to purchase
      client - the client completing the purchase
      Throws:
      BusinessException - if a sale cannot be recorded or stock cannot be updated
